title: pissen.png
description: A texture made for a private minecraft server, contains a lot of internal jokes. Maybe it's fun to pass the time. Change textures like paintings, the sun and moon, mobs like zombies, skeletons, ravengers, chickens,pigs, random items and more
body:
![Some itens here](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afa2eee2a031569da02e20a1c8e4419c3617df74.png)a joke resouce pack with a lot of dead memes and cursed things made for friends and also because I had nothing better to do, changes a lot of textures and models turning them into... things, like the sun, the moon, eggs, totem of undying, Villagers, skeletons, zombies, wardens, grass blocks, dirt and more!!! I thank the users abilalau (he owns ovini), moda_agiota, jm376 and drejr_ who helped me with some things for this resource pack, including this was originally intended for them.  hope you like it (:
